claims.statement: The article lists Tom Allen among the nineteen champions of the American prize ring.
claims.excerpt:
Jim Dunn, Bill Davis, Aaron Jones, Tom
Allen, Ned O’Baldwin

claims.statement: Bob Smith, the colored fighter, won decisive victories over Tom Allen and Harry Allen, which the writer calls two of the hardest fights ever recorded in the prize ring.

fights.notes: Undated and no place given. The article does not say whether this Tom Allen is the St. Louis champion.

notes: Champion list is a Boston Globe history reprinted by the Post-Dispatch. Hint on the list confirmed; hint on the Bob Smith fights kept at low confidence.
